page_text:
June 5, 2019 

Scott S. Harris, Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
1 First Street, NE 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

RE:  Bostock v. Clayton County, Georgia  

   (No. 17-1618) 
Altitude Express, Inc. v. Zarda  
   (No. 17-1623) 
R.G. & G.R. Harris Funeral Homes, Inc. v.   
   EEOC (No. 18-107) 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

On behalf of counsel for petitioner in No. 17-1618, 
respondents in No. 17-1623, and respondent Aimee Stephens 
in No. 18-107, I write to inform you that counsel for each of 
the parties listed above proposes to authorize John A. 
Knight, counsel of record for respondent Aimee Stephens in 
No. 18-107, to grant consent to the filing of amici curiae 
briefs.  Any consent granted by Mr. Knight would indicate 
that counsel for each of the parties has authorized him to 
consent on their behalf. 

  Respectfully, 

  Ria Tabacco Mar 

Counsel for Respondents 
Melissa Zarda et al. 

CC:   Brian J. Sutherland, Counsel of Record for Petitioner  

   Gerald Lynn Bostock 
Gregory Antollino, Counsel of Record for Respondents  
   Melissa Zarda et al. 
John A. Knight, Counsel of Record for Respondent  

        Aimee Stephens 

Denise McNerney, Deputy Clerk
